mainCharacter.name: Ollie
mainCharacter.role: Main character; a careful, kind neighborhood oil truck
mainCharacter.color: Round sunny-yellow tank body with navy blue trim and cream bumper accents
mainCharacter.bodyShape: Short rounded oil tanker with a soft oval tank, short hood, curved fenders, and no arms or hands
mainCharacter.face: Large soft hazel windshield eyes and a gentle smile in the front grille
mainCharacter.wheels: Four dark charcoal tires with navy hubcaps and tiny cream center dots
mainCharacter.accessories: Small navy side mirrors, a pale silver fill cap on the tank top, and a folded soft absorbent cloth roll tucked beside the rear bumper

setting.Quiet Corner Lane: A calm vehicle neighborhood with brick workshops, flower boxes, a gentle bend in the road, warm street lanterns, and a low stone curb
setting.visualStyle: Warm polished 3D children's illustration, soft rounded forms, clean single-scene compositions, gentle evening colors, and no readable text

style: Warm polished 3D children's animation illustration, bright friendly lighting, soft rounded forms, true 4:3 landscape single continuous scene. NO text, letters, numbers, badges, logos, watermarks, panels, collage, grid, comic layout, contact sheet, or multi-panel. Vehicles have NO arms, hands, or human limbs. Leave the bottom 25-30% of the frame as soft uncluttered ground/space so a narration panel can overlay later; keep all important subjects above the lower quarter.
continuityRules: Ollie keeps the same sunny-yellow tank, navy trim, cream bumper accents, soft hazel windshield eyes, and four matching wheels on every page.
Ollie and every vehicle have no human-like arms or hands.
Pippa remains a tiny mint-green sweep cart with cream brushes and blue windshield eyes.
The tiny oil puddle appears on Page 4 and shrinks through the soft cleanup until it is gone by Page 12.
The absorbent cloth roll appears with Ollie from Page 1 and is used during cleanup on Pages 8-11.
The sky progresses from golden evening to lavender dusk, soft twilight, and moonlit night.
Every illustration is one continuous scene with no panels, collage, grid, contact sheet, text, badge, logo, or watermark.
